presentation_modes.TACTICS: KINETIC_CEL, hero paint, clear board; no poster graphics
presentation_modes.IMPACT: KINETIC_CEL plus bounded archive offset and Memphis geometry

palette_provenance: Engineering swatches derived from the approved visual reference; source does not specify hex values.
implementation_notes: Colour values remain an implementation interpretation of the visual reference, not new Canon facts.
Surface texture is illustrated rather than photographic; material contrast must survive the normal tactical camera.
Three working yards keep different colour weights within the same industrial cel language.
runtime_fit_note: 2026-10-11: concrete and facade paint are distinct mid-value warm masses under neutral cel lighting. City service buildings now follow each caisson height and visibility; the back apron has physical UV office architecture. Same-camera comparison is required. No user acceptance implied.

tactical_unit_scale.source: 2026-10-12 user decision: shared tactical size tiers for allies, enemies and neutral units
tactical_unit_scale.micro_objects: People, machine dogs and explicitly small tools use approximately one quarter of a cell in plan area (half a cell per side).
tactical_unit_scale.exceptions: Explicit story / boss / special tool proportions retain their authored ratios.
tactical_unit_scale.shape: Keep each body proportion and silhouette; low bodies and long weapons must not miniaturise the whole unit.
tactical_unit_scale.rule_boundary: Display classes do not alter rule footprints, mass, clearance, movement or damage.
tactical_unit_scale.runtime_parameters: Current task specifications and unit_scale.gd; not project-wide metre ratios.
